title: Replay keystrokes
description:
A support tool records raw keystrokes from a terminal session, where `<` means the user pressed backspace.

Write `replay(keys)` that returns the text that was actually on screen at the end. A backspace on empty text does nothing.

**Example**

```
replay("pyy<thon")     # "python"
replay("ab<<<c")       # "c"
```
hints: Build the result as a list of characters and treat it as a stack.
`''.join(chars)` turns the list back into a string at the end.
